wiki.title: Celeste Rodriguez
wiki.extract: Celeste T. Rodriguez (born 1990) is an American politician who is a member of the California State Assembly representing the 43rd district, based in the eastern San Fernando Valley. Elected in the 2024 election, she previously served as a councilor and Mayor of San Fernando, California.
